items.description:
This is how it looks, Made with {heart} using Electron.js X React.js.The App background is the WebView DevTools itself.

Each item can be downloaded separately from trusted sources.

Packages are automatically downloaded.

Packages to download can be customized via Settings.

Local AI assistant integrated using Ollama.
